concept: The story is a price tag cut in half, so the hero sets the old value against the new one: 'Two purple caps. Rs 8 crore at SRH.' in muted grey, 'Now Rs 4 crore at Gujarat Titans.' in white. Slide 2 explains why with a bar chart of his wickets by season, two purple-cap bars shrinking to a bar that is barely there for 2026, and slide 3 makes that 0 huge on its own. The last slide turns to today's retention deadline and the Goa auction and asks fans to judge the deal. Business gold, type and charts only: no player photos, no team logos.
caption:
Two purple caps. Rs 8 crore at SRH. Now Rs 4 crore at Gujarat Titans.

Sunrisers Hyderabad have traded Harshal Patel to GT in an all-cash deal at a revised fee of Rs 4 crore, half of what they paid for him at the 2025 mega auction.

Why the drop? He took 16 wickets in 13 matches in his first SRH season. In IPL 2026 he played 5 matches, went at 10.82 an over and did not take a wicket.

He still has 151 IPL wickets and purple caps from 2021 (RCB) and 2024 (PBKS). GT will be his fifth IPL team.

The trade came on retention deadline day. All 10 teams name their retained and released players today and the mini-auction is in Goa on December 16.
